data.subject: A public-records research pilot
data.body:
Hi,

Your most recent 13F, for the period ended June 30, 2026, shows positions in CBAN, CBK, and FRST.

On September 17, CBAN disclosed a director or officer change in an 8-K Item 5.02 filing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/711669/000110465926108432/cban-20260917x8k.htm).

Local Ledger publishes independent research on under-covered US microcaps, built from local and state public records—permits, agendas, call reports, and filings—with every claim cited.

May I send the free weekly issue and outline a four-week fund pilot? Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
